item.title: H.S. BOYS BASKETBALL: What we learned from the Schuylkill League boys basketball semifinals
item.description: The script couldn’t have written itself any better for Pottsville and Minersville’s boys basketball teams this season. Both Pottsville (19-6, 12-2) and Minersville (22-1, 13-1) set up a rematch of last year’s Schuylkill League Championship when they picked up semifinal wins at Martz Hall Wednesday.
